problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is defined as $⟨x,y⟩=2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+2{x}_{3}{y}_{3}.$ 
Calculate the norm of the vector $v=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]$ under this inner product.
worked_solution:
The norm of a vector $v$ with respect to an inner product $⟨\cdot ,\cdot ⟩$ is defined as

$$
\begin{aligned}‖v‖=\sqrt{⟨v,v⟩}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $‖v‖$ using our definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖v‖ & =\sqrt{⟨v,v⟩} \\  & =\sqrt{2\cdot (2\cdot 2)+3\cdot 3+2\cdot (4\cdot 4)} \\  & =\sqrt{8+9+32} \\  & =\sqrt{49} \\  & =7.\end{aligned}
$$
